components.name: Primary button
components.css: .ds-primary {font: 400 14px/1.6 var(--font-body, monospace); border-radius: 0; min-height:48px; padding:12px 16px; font-weight:600; background:var(--accent, #33ff00); color:var(--background, #0a0a0a); border:1px solid var(--accent, #33ff00); transition:background-color 120ms, transform 120ms;} .ds-primary:hover {background:var(--accent-hover, #87ff68);} .ds-primary:focus-visible {outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #33ff00); outline-offset: 4px;} .ds-primary:active {transform:translate(1px,1px);} @media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce) {.ds-primary {transition:none;}}

components.name: Secondary button
components.css: .ds-secondary {font: 400 14px/1.6 var(--font-body, monospace); border-radius: 0; min-height:44px; padding:8px 16px; background:var(--panel, #111611); color:var(--text, #e8ebdd); border:1px solid var(--boundary, #63785d); transition:background-color 120ms, border-color 120ms, transform 120ms;} .ds-secondary:hover {background:var(--raised, #192019); border-color:var(--accent, #33ff00);} .ds-secondary:focus-visible {outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #33ff00); outline-offset: 4px;} .ds-secondary:active {transform:translate(1px,1px);} @media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce) {.ds-secondary {transition:none;}}

components.name: Numeric rectangle field
components.description: A labelled coordinate for an image selection.
components.css: .ds-field {font: 400 14px/1.6 var(--font-body, monospace); border-radius: 0; color:var(--text, #e8ebdd);} .ds-field input {font: 400 14px/1.6 var(--font-body, monospace); border-radius: 0; display:block; width:120px; min-height:44px; padding:8px; background:var(--panel, #111611); color:var(--text, #e8ebdd); border:1px solid var(--boundary, #63785d);} .ds-field input:focus-visible {outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #33ff00); outline-offset: 4px;}

components.name: Source navigation link
components.css: .ds-source {font: 400 14px/1.6 var(--font-body, monospace); border-radius: 0; color:var(--secondary, #a6b3a1);} .ds-source a {color:inherit; text-decoration:none;} .ds-source a:hover {color:var(--accent, #33ff00); text-decoration:underline; text-underline-offset:4px;} .ds-source a:focus-visible {outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #33ff00); outline-offset: 4px;}

components.name: Sample badge
components.css: .ds-badge {font: 400 14px/1.6 var(--font-body, monospace); border-radius: 0; display:inline-block; color:var(--info, #7ea2ff); border:1px solid var(--info, #7ea2ff); padding:4px 8px; font-size:12px; line-height:1.5;}

narrative.overview:
This name comes from the incumbent stylesheet. The interface uses near-black green surfaces, bright green actions, square geometry and monospaced text. It is a working instrument: the image, controls, explanations and inspection results carry the page.

The teaching library and PNG exercise inherit this system. Their content remains photographic medical imagery; the terminal treatment belongs to the surrounding interface.
keyCharacteristics: Dark, bordered panels with a bright green action accent.
Monospaced reading text and limited pixel-font display text.
Real image proportions, clear labels and explicit operation states.
Controls with plain-language hover and focus explanations.

rules.name: The Image Rule
rules.body: Keep decorative colour treatments out of image content. Preserve its source colours and proportions; draw temporary selection outlines only as an editing aid.

dos: Do reuse the existing semantic colours and local fonts.
Do keep image proportions and source colours intact.
Do describe status and limits in text beside the operation.
Do preserve keyboard focus, readable labels and wrapping controls.
donts: Don't apply terminal tint, pixelation or decorative scanlines to the medical image.
Don't use the display pixel font for long explanations or metadata lists.
Don't communicate completion or failure through colour alone.
